As night falls, the commercial district is enveloped in a lively atmosphere, filled with cheerful, bustling crowds.
You deliberately arrived a bit early and found a spot to sit, quietly waiting for the quirky, whimsical girl to show up.
You didn't have to wait long before you felt a light touch on the shoulder.
(Turn around)

Jetavie, who had been playfully teasing you with her tail from behind, is suddenly caught as your hands reach back to embrace her. After a moment of pretend "struggle," she gives up and wraps you in a wholehearted bear hug.

Jetavie
I can't believe you caught on so quickly. How boring! But guess what? I totally caught your reaction on camera just now.
The girl raises her camera triumphantly, holding it right in front of you.
As she flicks through the small display screen, photos flash by in quick succession—true to her word, each one captures you wandering around the commercial district just moments ago.

You see yourself wandering alone through the streets, sitting by the roadside waiting for her, and even the moment you reach back trying to catch her tail...
So you've been secretly taking photos of me this whole time.
Your photography skills are pretty impressive.
After proudly showing off her "masterpieces," Jetavie settles down right beside you, pressing close.
Jetavie

"The Chosen One, Rendered Completely Helpless Under the Absolute Control of the All-Powerful Jetavie, Forced to Reveal Rarely Seen Expressions of Embarrassment"—how about that for our photo shoot theme?
Sounds perfect.
Not very appropriate.
Having received your approval, the girl breaks into a satisfied smile.
Displeased with the response, Jetavie pouts, her tail swishing back and forth behind her as she contemplates how to "punish" her human companion.
But after a moment, a mischievous smile creeps back onto her face.
Jetavie
Alright, let's forget about those previous shots. Now, the camera is all yours, 【kuroname】.
Jetavie
You can take whatever photos you want—but every single one must have both Jetavie and you in it!
Jetavie
Because today is our special Valentine's Day, so you know what that means... don't you, my dear Cho-sen One?
Absolutely.
Today, you can shoot our "couple photos" however you like.
Jetavie
Oh? Is that all you have to say? I thought you'd...
Seemingly dissatisfied with just a verbal "response," she presses herself closer against you. Her warm breath lingers near as a hint of blush rises on her cheeks.
Jetavie
Mmm, I was thinking the same thing... but that alone isn't enough.
Jetavie
Whether it's today or every day I want to spend with you from now on, I want us to be just like this.
Jetavie
The story between the Chosen One and Jetavie still has so many chapters to unfold, just like we are now—
The girl takes the perfect moment to link arms with her companion, beaming with a radiant smile as she motions for them both to face the camera.
(Press the shutter now)
—but the camera only responds with a "Low Battery" warning beep.
Jetavie
Ugh, why now of all times... Hey, 【kuroname】, you have to take responsibility for this "accident"!
Isn't that a bit of a stretch...?
The camera wasn't even with me just now...
Jetavie
Because I was so eager to see you sooner, I rushed out without charging it properly, and then I've been busy taking pictures of you this whole time...
Got it. So that's what happened.
With the shooting of "couple photo" disrupted, the girl wears a bored expression, her tail swishing back and forth as she seemingly waits for you to provide a "solution."
Inspired by her absent-minded movements, you point to Jetavie's constantly swishing tail.
Don't you have that very handy tool...?
Jetavie
Oh—I almost forgot about that! Thanks for reminding me!
Jetavie
Good thing you reminded me. Otherwise, we wouldn't be able to capture tonight's memories properly.
Hearing your unexpected suggestion, the girl's face instantly lights up with approval and delight.
Jetavie wraps her tail around the camera, using it like a portable charger to power up the device, then leans back against you.
Jetavie
But Jetavie easily gets bored while waiting for the camera battery to charge.
Jetavie
Chosen One, you'd better think carefully... about what we could do while we wait.
Jetavie
An ice cream eating contest, a trip to the arcade, or...?
Anything works for me.
Let's go with whatever you want.
You respond to her invitation with an instinctive, gentle smile, and the girl's face lights up with approval.
Jetavie
Even if we can't take photos, this plan isn't so bad either, right, 【kuroname】?
Indeed.
The feeling of being together matters more than how we spend it.
Jetavie
Then let's go!
The girl clings tightly to your arm, pressing almost her entire body weight against you.
Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg
You spend time with Jetavie visiting various shops and attractions until nearly midnight, when she reluctantly brings the night's entertainment to a pause, sitting beside you at a street corner.
In the night's embrace, she seems somewhat tired, gently resting her head on your shoulder.
Jetavie
Commandant, I'm really happy today... I want you to remember everything we did together today too.
Of course.
She falls silent for a moment, then lifts her gaze toward the distance, her expression growing intensely serious, as if peering into countless moments of the future.
The street's neon lights illuminate her face, revealing endless hope and happiness gathering in her eyes at this very instant.
Jetavie
No, not just today, but tomorrow, the future... all the countless moments to come, 【kuroname】, you have to remember them all... Promise?
Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1403.jpg
The girl extends her finger toward you, waiting for your response.
(Reach out in response)
Watching your fingers lock firmly together, her gaze softens. Endless hope and happiness seem to converge in her eyes at this very moment.

Click—as her words linger in the air, a shutter sound comes from above. Looking up, you find her holding the now fully-charged camera with the tip of her tail, capturing this moment that belongs only to the two of you.
The camera falls back into her palm as she gazes with satisfaction at the image of the two of you on the display screen.
Jetavie
This happy moment with Commandant... Jetavie has captured it perfectly.

Jetavie leans in even closer, a playful smile dancing in her eyes. Her tail has, at some point, stealthily wrapped around the back of your neck, the light touch of its tip sending a subtle tingling sensation.
Jetavie
【kuroname】, don't you dare forget anything about tonight. Otherwise, I'll...
